{"metadata":{"description":"基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的远程访问方案，通过低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 网络，支持使用 PC、移动端 和 Web 随时访问本地设备上的DSH 、CodeX、Cursor、Claude Code等工作区。 (Built on DeepSeek Harness plugins, this low-latency, end-to-end encrypted P2P solution lets PC, mobile, and web clients access local DSH, Codex, Cursor, and Claud","id":"gh:1334325657","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"ds-harness-remote","slug":"liguobao/ds-harness-remote","topics":["deepseek","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的远程访问方案，通过低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 网络，支持使用 PC、移动端 和 Web 随时访问本地设备上的DSH 、CodeX、Cursor、"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Claude Code等工作区。 (Built on DeepSeek Harness plugins, this low-latency, end-to-end encrypted P2P solu"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"tion lets PC, mobile, and web clients access local DSH, Codex, Cursor, and Claud"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"日本語"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Connect once. Ready whenever you are."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Continue using your DeepSeek Harness instance from a phone, computer, or browser. Return to the same"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" Harness session from whichever device is with you."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Harness keeps running on your work computer, with the same workspaces, tools, and project setup. DS "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"Harness Remote is simply another window into that environment."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The DeepSeek Harness desktop edition is supported. Install the latest release:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Access your local Harness instance remotely from the web, a PC, or a mobile device: DSH first, wit"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"h Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity support too.
- DeepSeek Harness Desktop is ready to use after insta"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"llation, with its native interface and no separate desktop conversation UI.
- Create workspaces, con"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"figure models, and switch conversation models with the same smooth workflow as local use.
- No publi"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"c listening port or public IP is required on the Harness Host. Connect from anywhere with internet a"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ccess over a bidirectional end-to-end encrypted channel.
- Prefer P2P connections, use TURN relay no"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"des worldwide, and fall back to multiple Server Relays when needed.
- Access workspace files, read-o"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"nly previews, remote terminals, and authorized local development-service previews through the native"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" Harness sidebar.
- Remote Tool context injection supports Host and workspace discovery, Harness ses"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"sion creation and management, history reading, waiting for execution, interruption requests, and aut"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"horized file transfers. Details.
- Alongside DeepSeek Harness, access native workspaces for Codex, C"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ursor, Google Antigravity, Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, Harness Agent, and other tools through ACP int"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"egrations, with remote file browsing and terminals.
- Clients are available across Android, iOS, Web"},{"id":"p11s14","text":", and native DSH.
- Multiple clients can connect to the same Harness Host simultaneously, with RPC c"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"alls and streams isolated per connection."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Supported clients"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Client | Form | Status | Notes |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| DSH Desktop plugin | Remote sidebar | Supported | Install `ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`; this computer"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" can also be the Host |
| Web | Browser page | Supported | Open https://dsh.r2049.cn; reuses the nat"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ive Harness interface |
| Android | Native app | Supported | Download the APK from Releases; see the"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" Android guide |
| DSH Go | A standout app by ccch1mneyyy | Supported | See ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go: an A"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ndroid client for DeepSeek Harness. Run it directly on your phone or control DSH on your computer re"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"motely. |
| iOS | TestFlight beta | Beta | Not publicly released; see issue #20 |
| Browser extensio"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"n | Chrome | Entry point only | Exchanges an already signed-in Web authorization for a separate devi"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ce credential, lists online Hosts and opens the same-origin Remote Web; it does not host a conversat"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ion UI |
| dsh-TUI | Terminal-only CLI | Planned | Integration is not part of this release and retur"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"ns in a later version; the installer never creates a Web service for it automatically |
| Linux | Cl"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"oud server | Supported | Sign in on the official website to install with one command. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Several clients can connect to the same Host at once; RPC calls and streams are isolated per connect"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ral clients can connect to the same Host at once; RPC calls and streams are isolated per connection."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### DeepSeek Harness Desktop support"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Open **Extensions / Plugin management** in DeepSeek Harness Desktop, choose installation
from npm, a"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nd enter this package:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Restart Desktop afterward. Its official `dsh` launcher can also install the pinned package
with `dsh"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" plugin --profile desktop add -w ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"On DSH 0.2.2+, npm installations support version checks and updates in Plugin management, with an at"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tempt to restore the previous version if hot updating fails. GitHub and local link installations mus"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t switch to npm first; see online updates."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Linux one-command installation"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Visit https://dsh.r2049.cn, sign in, and obtain an installation authorization code to install with o"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"://dsh.r2049.cn, sign in, and obtain an installation authorization code to install with one command."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The Harness Host does not need a public listening port. Connect from anywhere with internet access o"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ver ds-harness-remote’s bidirectional end-to-end encrypted channel."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The client switches to the selected Host’s native Harness API, keeping the original workspaces, tool"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"s, and permission flows on that computer."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"You can also edit Harness and plugin settings on the remote host. Available options depend on which "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"settings Harness and each plugin expose through the official settings API."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- On LAN and P2P paths, data bypasses the Server except for connection coordination. TURN uses the o"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"pen-source coturn server; Relay mode forwards traffic over WebSocket.
- Session traffic is end-to-en"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"d encrypted. The service relays ciphertext without storing session plaintext or device private keys."},{"id":"p30s4","text":"
- Same-account devices connect without extra confirmation; see device trust and permissions.
- Remo"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"te Tools injection — optional `remote_*` session tools; enabled by default and configurable in detai"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"led Remote settings.
- Interactive terminals use the Host-local `terminal.enabled` switch (on by def"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"ault). They run as the Host user, independently of Agent approvals.
- General tool RPC and remote de"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"sktop are not exposed.
- The workspace picker lists folders only and returns bounded, read-only dire"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"ctory metadata.
- Remote file preview cannot write, delete, upload, execute, or open a path in an ex"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"ternal application.
- Codex Remote / Agent ACP is optional, can be disabled, and follows the same en"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"crypted Host permission boundary as the rest of Remote.
- Removing a device revokes its credentials,"},{"id":"p30s12","text":" membership, and active Remote connections."}],"truncated":true}
